title: Whole, half and quarter turns
summary: Use position words and explore turns in both directions.
subject: maths

difficultyRamp.within: Q1 uses in front and behind. Q2 uses above and below. Q3 identifies a 2-quarter turn from up. Q4 identifies a 4-quarter turn from right. Q5 predicts a 2-quarter turn from up. Q6 predicts a 2-quarter turn from right. Q7 predicts a 4-quarter turn from down. Q8 predicts a 4-quarter turn from left. Q9 predicts a 1-quarter turn from up. Q10 predicts a 1-quarter turn from right.
difficultyRamp.versus: Easy uses position words, whole and half turns, then supported quarter-turn predictions. Medium identifies and predicts quarter and half turns in both directions. Hard adds three-quarter turns, varied starts and whole-turn distinctions. All use one shared arrow diagram and single-choice spatial fluency to avoid interaction changes.

questions.prompt: Pip is in front of a tree. Where is the tree?
questions.explanation: The tree is behind Pip because Pip is in front of it.

questions.prompt: A bird is above Pip. Where is Pip?
questions.explanation: Pip is below the bird because the bird is above him.

questions.prompt: Follow the orange path. How much does the arrow turn?
questions.explanation: A half turn goes halfway round.
questions.hint: Trace the path with your finger. Clockwise goes the same way as the hands on a clock.

questions.prompt: Follow the orange path. How much does the arrow turn?
questions.explanation: A whole turn goes all the way round and finishes in the starting direction.
questions.hint: Trace the path with your finger. Clockwise goes the same way as the hands on a clock.

questions.prompt: The arrow makes a half turn clockwise. Which way does it point now?
questions.explanation: From pointing up, a half turn clockwise finishes pointing down.
questions.hint: Imagine turning the arrow halfway round.

questions.prompt: The arrow makes a half turn clockwise. Which way does it point now?
questions.explanation: From pointing right, a half turn clockwise finishes pointing left.

questions.prompt: The arrow makes a whole turn clockwise. Which way does it point now?
questions.explanation: From pointing down, a whole turn clockwise finishes pointing down.

questions.prompt: The arrow makes a whole turn clockwise. Which way does it point now?
questions.explanation: From pointing left, a whole turn clockwise finishes pointing left.

questions.prompt: The arrow makes a quarter turn clockwise. Which way does it point now?
questions.explanation: From pointing up, a quarter turn clockwise finishes pointing right.
questions.hint: A quarter turn is one of four equal steps around a circle. Clockwise goes the same way as clock hands.

questions.prompt: The arrow makes a quarter turn clockwise. Which way does it point now?
questions.explanation: From pointing right, a quarter turn clockwise finishes pointing down.
